members.name: Instrumental members of Stone Temple Pilots (excluding Scott Weiland)

podcast.title: Formation (Post-STP)
podcast.body: Formed by the DeLeo brothers from Stone Temple Pilots and Richard Patrick from Filter, but the project ultimately "nothing much happened." "The Delayos formed a new band called Army of Anyone with Richard Patrick a Filter, but nothing much happened."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 1

podcast.title: New Project Post-STP
podcast.body: This band was formed by the remaining members of Stone Temple Pilots after the final dissolution of STP with Scott Weiland. "Meanwhile, the guys in Stone Tip of Pilots have a new project called Army of Anyone."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
